entities.title: utv for Python
entities.summary: The Python library of UTV, version 0.3.0: typed values and outcomes on top of the JSON-level everyday API, the text form, and explicit interop with datetime.
entities.purpose: Holds the package utv (src/utv/), its tests and worked examples (tests/), the project file that builds it (pyproject.toml), and the README and CHANGELOG a person reads first. It reads and writes utv/1.0, needs Python 3.10 or later and nothing outside the standard library.
boundaries: The contracts it implements are the repository's: docs/library-api.md, docs/everyday-api.md, docs/text-form.md and spec/. Where they disagree with the code, the fix is decided there.
Its tests read conformance/ and schema/ at the repository root in place; the library itself reads only its copy of the schema in src/utv/data/.
Zone rules are the caller's input. The library ships none, and never reads the host's tz database, clock or locale.
Conformance profiles claimed: none yet. Registries shipped: none (README).
